name: Acid Blast
body:
School evocation [acid]; Level cleric/oracle 7, druid 7, sorcerer/wizard 6

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Area cone-shaped burst
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw Reflex half; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

Acid blast releases a bolt of caustic acid from your hands that extends outward in a cone. The roiling waves of acid do not harm any creatures or objects in the area that you wish to exclude from damage. Any other creature within the area takes 1d6 points of acid damage per caster level (maximum 15d6).
